issue: A blanket exclusion of 25 private cases incorrectly describes product safety and quality guardrails as non-product repository maintenance. Useful obligations include public/test-only signer separation, secretless production source, validator ownership and current CLI instructions, with positive and negative controls.
requested_resolution: Preserve private case paths/IDs in protected storage. Publish one opaque case-hash disposition per case, binding retained equivalent source controls or mandatory post-import replacements. Explicitly retire only superseded claims; recipe/owner/topology obligations must map to the accepted new boundaries. No wholesale private audit tool or document import is required.
resolution: Twenty-five individual opaque case dispositions preserve 21 product/integration guardrails through explicit positive/negative replacements and retire only four superseded editorial/taxonomy assertions. The public-owner-link case was corrected to its actual original claim. No private paths/IDs were published.
status: resolved for pre-import admission; replacement execution remains mandatory after import
